summary: RMG ML Sports Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the partial exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option in its IPO. On June 11, 2026, it closed its IPO of 20M units at $10/unit. Subsequently, on June 15, 2026, it issued 1.65M additional units at $10/unit, raising $16.5M, which was deposited into the trust account, bringing total trust proceeds to $216.5M. The filing is a routine current report concerning IPO proceeds and over-allotment exercise, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer; there are no deal terms as this is not a merger or acquisition.
